title: `get_check_constraints` result changed in SQLAlchemy 2.0.33-34

labels.name: blocker

labels.name: reflection

body:
### Describe the bug

I encountered problems noted in #11832, but I found a case not handled by the fix.

```python
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, inspect, CheckConstraint, MetaData
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
from typing import Optional


METADATA = MetaData()

class BaseModel(DeclarativeBase):
    metadata = METADATA

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)


class Example(BaseModel):
    __tablename__ = 'example'
    value: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(doc="Name of the HTML body template.")
    value_2: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(
        CheckConstraint('value_2 IS NULL OR value IS NOT NULL',
                        name='value_2_check'))

    next_value: Mapped[str]


# Create an in-memory SQLite database and create the table
engine = create_engine('sqlite:////tmp/test.db')
BaseModel.metadata.create_all(engine)

inspector = inspect(engine)
print(inspector.get_check_constraints("example"))
# 2.0.32 correct
# [{'sqltext': 'value_2 IS NULL OR value IS NOT NULL', 'name': 'value_2_check'}]
# 2.0.33, 2.0.34 incorrect
# [{'sqltext': 'value_2 IS NULL OR value IS NOT NULL), \n\tnext_value VARCHAR NOT NULL, \n\tid INTEGER NOT NULL, \n\tPRIMARY KEY (id', 'name': 'value_2_check'}]
```

Schema from the sqlite:
```
CREATE TABLE example (
	value VARCHAR,
	value_2 VARCHAR CONSTRAINT value_2_check CHECK (value_2 IS NULL OR value IS NOT NULL),
	next_value VARCHAR NOT NULL,
	id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
```
